Use litlfred workflow now"; smart-base#156 is the model). `ig`: fhir-harness's `ig` content type; `include` is everything the harness reads in this repository, and nothing else is read (owner, 2026-10-30: "harness desclares what it it pays attention to in the repo"). It lists every `input/` entry the build used before the section existed, so nothing is dropped; sushi-config.yaml stays SUSHI's file.
